HyperFrames v0.8.196

Released on 2026-10-25.

Undoing a rename of a video or audio file works again: the file comes back under its old name. The CLI's add, check and archive commands get fixes too, and cache-busted images stay visible in bundles.

Fixes

  • Studio Server: Undoing a video rename brings the file back under its old name (7bc363c87c, #6285).
  • Deps: Update esbuild for the security advisory (38afc0b013, #6277).
  • CLI: Stop 'hyperframes add' hanging when a desktop clipboard is available (221f3671f2, #6271).
  • Core: Keep cache-busted images visible in bundles (32d2d3cba0, #6264).
  • CLI: Include encoded external assets in archives (c6c8d81ba3, #6266).
  • CLI: Remove stale briefs when re-freezing recipes (f5e15b2f77, #5324).
  • CLI: Check finishes on long projects with many video clips (37f5f27290, #6270).

Full changelog

item.description:

Released on 2026-10-25.

  • Player: Keep Next available for the final slide's reveals (680f5d7465e63, #6233).
  • Sdk: Keep added elements when reopening saved overrides (31e6ed2aed959, #6231).
  • CLI: Emit valid JSON for filtered keyframes (6a917780f5903, #6228).
  • Lint: Accept GLSL script blocks without JavaScript syntax errors (f21c3e3e7e838, #6227).
  • Producer: Report unavailable frame checks in debug logs (0c3387b8beeb7, #6200).
  • Lint: Accept final font-family descriptors without semicolons (035a5c0ae1f9f, #6085).
  • Skills: Preserve Remotion easing mappings (6a2721c68a58c, #5561).
  • Producer: Keep runtime media speed in exports (066bc51831ebb, #5528).
  • Core: Prepare split-video offsets during preview preload (abcbde0b97ad9, #5356).
  • Render: Align container Chrome with the CLI (d6c20513d1f22, #5338).
  • Core: Resolve a relative data-start inside the clip's own composition (c2a6b15f6fcc1, #5336).
  • CLI: Report parent motion in template-wrapped keyframes (d36797a3b57d6, #5331).
  • CLI: Preserve ducking gain when music starts later (ad41745ab104a, #5318).
  • CLI: Preserve distinct font URLs during capture (f9d72a3f73753, #5312).
  • CLI: Include external video posters in project archives (e5e2d6f1df036, #5309).
  • CLI: Include captured raster formats in contact sheets (bb5e0f0bcf970, #5301).
  • CLI: Respect reference image orientation in grade comparisons (39364ee4fb520, #5288).
  • CLI: Reap only orphaned browsers HyperFrames launched (f180ffca64b4b, #6251).
  • Core: Motion blur no longer blacks out videos inside sub-compositions (b97de59c84a75, #6252).
  • Core: A video that starts a cut far behind the playhead catches up in steps, not at a flat 3% (e586922cd1e0c, #6198).
  • Studio: Allow a local GSAP dependency mirror (1c14fbb542897, #6247).
  • CLI: Allow disabling orphan browser cleanup (aefca2144c200, #6213).
  • Core: Name the selector when a scoped GSAP target matches nothing (e26d330887896, #5839).
  • Producer: A busy composition no longer stalls the render waiting on probe-page reads (9aadc0b9b99d9, #6241).
  • CLI: A Chrome download that stops sending is abandoned, retried, and releases the lock (fcec26ed5f35a, #6222).

Docs & Examples

  • Protect skill edits during contributor setup (0289d96ac78ab, #5346).
  • Studio App: Show the app working, three new pages, today's UI (7224812143d52, #6223).

Catalog

  • CLI: Refresh item manifests when bypassing registry cache (9a517560a827b, #5256).

Internal

  • CLI: Cover media URL duration probes (ecd7bf4184fe1, #5330).
  • Engine: Retry the alpha probe test's temp-dir cleanup when Windows holds a file (ab57d0ee14468, #6234).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.8.193
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.193

Released on 2026-10-24.

Cloud renders of long, cut-heavy edits finish several times faster at the same or lower cost. Audio renders work again on FFmpeg 4.4.

Fixes

  • Engine: Audio encodes on FFmpeg 4.4, which has no setts duration option (3d45d1b037860, #6219).
  • CLI: Each start sweeps the running markers of CLIs that are gone (24965372dbbec, #5790).
  • CLI: Snapshot rejects a negative --at and builds its sheet from its own frames (80be6ff039bb7, #6179).
  • CLI: Snapshot seeks into a HEVC cut whose index lands a keyframe early (3cbd98890e6f6, #6217).
  • Studio Server: A history restore refuses to remove every tracked file (0eae4946d33f3, #6175).
  • Engine: Disable Dawn's DXC on Windows so WebGPU requestDevice succeeds (3dc0b97bfdfe3, #5830).
  • Studio: A scene swap no longer keeps the previous preview window in memory (291144e87ddfe, #6207).
  • Core: Color grading builds a new WebGL context when a lost one is never restored (700187b855de3, #6211).
  • Producer: A render's page-error count includes what the capture workers saw (1ab871fb117aa, #6196).
  • Engine: Renames ride out Windows file locks instead of failing the render (0a8a78edec413, #6210).

Performance

  • AWS Lambda: Cloud renders plan without reading video bytes and start chunks sooner (da4386f0d0695, #6194).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: Say which font faces are bundled and which are fetched (8811f0bfbf3e7, #6197).

Internal

  • CLI: The lifecycle suite lets background imports settle before it resets modules (dd1cba49de4e1, #6216).
  • The lifecycle and thumbnail suites load cold modules in a hook, not in their first test (1a238171ec558, #6212).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.8.192
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.192

Released on 2026-10-24.

H265 and HDR renders work again on machines with more than 16 cores. Cloud renders of long, cut-heavy edits spend far less time probing and reading audio.

Fixes

  • Engine: H265 renders no longer fail on hosts with more than 16 cores (53e1dfce9e6a, #6193).
  • CLI: A check that hits its deadline keeps the findings it already made (ebb057fb62f1, #6190).
  • CLI: Normalize muted targets before applying tolerance (0b8f5ec8f5ae, #5291).
  • Core: Release decoded preview audio once no clip uses its source (09d7f1c64660, #6178).
  • Studio Server: Project history no longer copies video, audio or huge files (5ebbc8ef6dbf, #6171).
  • CLI: Audit clipped text beneath transparent composition hosts (2a9b9f4e7c2f, #5400).
  • CLI: Refuse undo when a target or backup is missing (9ab4de459988, #5365).
  • Lint: Check timeline registration before explicit font loads (191caf943ab5, #5363).
  • Studio Server: Decode authored audio attributes for loudness (0aa728b1aa24, #5289).
  • CLI: Stage temporary HTML comparisons without recursive copies (bd0be1bdae15, #5286).
  • Core: Preserve blocked addresses in mounted import maps (ecf5db7070c4, #5277).
  • Lint: Read actual font CSS declarations (a1b23f1e4dd2, #5221).
  • CLI: Fail benchmarks with no completed renders (9e533f0887cd, #5303).
  • CLI: Read info metadata from the root composition (8a84bedd38b2, #5299).
  • CLI: Capture images declared only through srcset (1001a7941983, #5298).
  • Parsers: Recognize spaced slideshow type attributes (0a37f9b9bb34, #5326).
  • CLI: Close asset streams when clients disconnect (410030a7331b, #5321).
  • CLI: Preserve portrait orientation during background removal (58752b5cf3e2, #5313).
  • CLI: Tolerate invalid optional package cache manifests (1e6a2f0ff92f, #5349).
  • CLI: Honor HTML attribute casing in frame-rate defaults (c00a1bc1d427, #5348).
  • Core: Preserve literal percent in beat source paths (234b87a4bbbd, #5327).
  • CLI: Preserve stylesheet order during website capture (ad06c60c7402, #5311).
  • CLI: Detect beats from child media sources (e10155ce35b1, #5310).
  • CLI: Retain metadata when Lottie previews exceed the size limit (58578fc22974, #5307).
  • CLI: Show complete history diffs for large text changes (ac6c682a0d77, #5305).
  • Engine: Preserve Windows RSS samples after a query failure (ba5dde78de2e, #5357).
  • Engine: Recognize spaced closing template tags (cad57bf2aa46, #5353).
  • Engine: Retain fresh frames when replacing an empty cache (6fccefe9761b, #5351).
  • CLI: Tolerate removed files during desktop catch-up (e7f6c12b9166, #5350).
  • CLI: Respect image orientation in capture contact sheets (e0317a23c09a, #5295).
  • CLI: Protect batch input from generated manifest (d94a9d7aabb3, #5294).
  • CLI: Init never touches installed skills and no command removes one (0d104e6fca49, #6168).
  • Studio: Preserve caption text when parsing transcripts (886e8696dfc4, #3896).

Performance

  • Producer: The audio task finds sound with a probe and reads URL clips in parallel (acb47de7d298, #6174).
  • Engine: A site's remote files are probed once per render, not once per clip (da3e9b6385ef, #6172).

Docs & Examples

  • Clarify Claude Code plugin auto-update steps (fa5dbd12c969, #5120).

Internal

  • Engine: The GPU probe tests do not start a Chrome from the host cache (3ef28e26c6f4, #6187).
  • Core: Isolate local font fallback from system discovery (14c9eb448751, #5360).
  • Use supported FFmpeg flags for VFR fixtures (bd4d8c6cb5bc, #5352).

Full changelog

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.191

Released on 2026-10-24.

A deleted layer that a script still looks up now stays hidden instead of coming back, and a script that throws no longer blocks a render. Preview loads only the clips due next, so it holds up on slow links.

Features

  • Studio: Motion blur panel with Off / Subtle / Strong (ffc327b44, #6112).
  • CLI: Check writes a progress line to stderr per sample, overlap batch and craft frame (55cbc0e15, #6151).

Fixes

  • CLI: Exclude rendering flags from tween tail warnings (84e6dfd24, #5711).
  • Engine: Redraw a small drawElement frame before failing the serial capture (c478110be, #5748).
  • Core: Preview fetches only the clips due next, and drops passed clips still downloading (179098936, #6160).
  • Core: A hidden child of a mover stays out of the blur trail (e077d9dc7, #6155).
  • Sdk: A kept delete drops its media sources and a hidden video is not waited for (44100a537, #6163).
  • Studio: Audio clips in the timeline share the video clip corner radius (579f73bf2, #6159).
  • CLI: Snapshot waits for the image layers a seek reveals before capturing (1552f52fb, #6161).
  • Engine: A composition whose script throws is skipped with a warning, not refused (8df9b6dd3, #6156).
  • Sdk: A stored delete a script still looks up is hidden when overrides replay, not removed (dad825945, #6143).

Performance

  • AWS Lambda: A render reads a video's audio from a small file stored beside it (3439433d6, #6162).

Docs & Examples

  • CLI: Apply review notes from #5442 to open, timeline and history (fb8aadad1, #6110).
  • Skills: Remove duplicated sections in skill references (d5526bd48, #6164).

Internal

  • Engine: Only h264 is held to identical bytes across host sizes (19cc96e3f, #6167).

Full changelog

HyperFrames v0.8.185

Released on 2026-10-21.

hyperframes cloud render --resolution 4k now works for transparent MOV and WebM. A render no longer fails when its audio peak stalls under correction, check accepts projects that inline the GSAP library, and cloud render chunks start their capture browsers while video frames extract.   • Engine: A capture browser whose BeginFrame probe passed keeps BeginFrame capture when closing the probe page is slow (a8b576d15, #6037).

  • Producer: A cloud render chunk starts its capture browsers while its video frames are still being extracted, so heavy chunks finish sooner and cost less (0716670fa, #6031).

Released on 2026-10-21.

hyperframes cloud render now takes projects whose media is far larger than the project upload limit. Multi-worker mp4 renders start encoding while they capture, Lambda chunks run more capture browsers at once, and a heavy project's preview builds faster.   • CLI: A preview refused inside a host app no longer stops other Chrome processes left behind by earlier runs (5641a9179, #6022).

  • Producer: A multi-worker mp4 render starts encoding while its frames are still being captured, instead of after, with byte-identical output (eec3c51d7, #5952).

  • Core: A heavy project's first preview page builds sooner, without rescanning its styles once per composition variable (0d51eb0de, #5893).
  • Core: A page build reads fonts, inlined assets and scenes mounted many times only once, and an offline build with a warm font cache makes no network request (884d8690a, #5954).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.183

Released on 2026-10-21.

v0.8.182 was tagged but never reached npm (its publish stopped at the package size check), so everything listed for it ships in this release.

Website capture now handles pages that reload after a cookie banner, CLI commands start faster, a repeat check starts with the CLI and Chrome already up, and snapshot and check wait for late images as render does. Renders inside a macOS sandbox no longer fail, a sharp sound at a film's start no longer grows louder with each audio pass, and lambda sites create takes source files over 5 GB. Cloud renders mix their audio beside the chunks and fail loudly when an audio read is cut off, a 4K camera shown small reaches Chrome near the size it is drawn, a finished capture exits even when a site's DNS never answers, and an unreadable frame fails a render instead of shortening it.

Features

  • AWS Lambda: A cloud render mixes its audio on its own Lambda while the chunks render, instead of before them, so a long film finishes sooner (dee8380d2, #5997).
  • Producer: A cloud plan can leave its audio out and build that track on its own, which the Lambda change above uses (8b410f1cb, #5988).
  • Registry: New echo-smear component: a streak of copies that trails an element as a GSAP timeline moves it faster (23e7a384b, #5980).

Fixes

  • CLI: Website capture waits for a page that reloads after its cookie banner closes, so assets and scroll screenshots are no longer empty (0693839b5, #4949).
  • CLI: check prints progress while it makes browser-playable copies of phone videos (b7fa007bf, #5953).
  • CLI: check, snapshot and Studio show accented and non-Latin project text correctly instead of garbled (6d357ff0d, #5843).
  • CLI: check no longer calls a film static when it moves only through an SVG mask or clip path, a stroke reveal or a canvas (0bd626825, #5960).

item.title: v0.8.156
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.156

Released on 2026-10-14.

Videos from screen recordings no longer freeze partway through on FFmpeg 8. Segmented renders with several workers start faster when media is slow to load, and long audio mixes do less work. @hyperframes/inspector no longer ships agent tools, so harnesses define their own.

Breaking Changes

  • Inspector: Stop shipping agent tools. Harnesses now define their own (abe97f6e4c, #5570). inspect_components, query_timeline, the stdio MCP server and the componentsTool, timelineTool, toolContent and InspectionTool exports from @hyperframes/inspector/live are gone. The HTTP contract (POST /inspect, /timeline, /element-map) is unchanged, and InspectRequest and TimelineRequest are now exported so a harness can build its own schema.

Fixes

  • Engine: Renders under WSL use the GPU through full Chrome when the headless shell cannot (9b996059af, #5574). It used to fall back to software rendering.
  • Producer: Start segmented render workers together so slow media waits overlap (d77b03c24c, #5573). Each worker used to wait for the one before it to finish loading media.
  • Engine: Sample VFR video by timestamp so it does not freeze on FFmpeg 8 (6afcb48395, #5572). FFmpeg 8 honours frame durations, so screen recordings with long, overlapping frames held one frame and dropped the rest. Cached frames from older versions are re-extracted.
  • Engine: Avoid padding every audio mix input (3de4763d53, #5563). Short clips no longer stay in the mix for the whole composition, so audio work no longer grows with clip count times length.

Internal

  • Studio: Run the edit accuracy slice on PRs and the full grid in the merge queue (9a2c1c6e80, #5566).

Full changelog

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.155

Released on 2026-10-13.

MP4 renders at widths like 1000, 1080 or 1112 no longer get a black strip down the right edge on newer FFmpeg. Both the Studio render route and the producer render server now take encoder settings such as CRF, and distributed renders keep the CRF you ask for.

Features

  • Producer: The render server's /render and /render/stream accept crf, videoBitrate and videoFrameFormat (5de2712ad5, #5550). A bad videoFrameFormat now returns a 400 instead of being ignored.
  • Studio Server: Accept crf, videoBitrate, videoFrameFormat and hdrMode on the render route (ab8a4da53f, #5549). Out-of-range values return a 400, and crf with videoBitrate together is rejected.

  • Engine: Keep the rightmost 8 columns of SDR MP4 at widths like 1080 (401354cd8f, #5559). FFmpeg 7.1 and 8.0 dropped the last 8 pixel columns to black when the width was 8 more than a multiple of 16.
  • Producer: Keep the requested CRF in the distributed constant-frame-rate re-encode (bf4cf860fb, #5557). It used to fall back to the quality preset.

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.152

Released on 2026-10-13.

Check and snapshot save each run in its own folder tied to the revision it came from, and renders clean up evidence from old revisions. Project history keeps .hyperframes/video-state.json current after every edit and records which element each edit targeted. Agents sharing a project can refuse to start while another agent's turn is open (--exclusive), end only their own turn (--who), and end safely when no turn is open (--if-open).

  • Default snapshots moved from snapshots/ to .hyperframes/artifacts/snapshots/<id>/. Check reports are written to .hyperframes/artifacts/checks/<id>.json. A render also writes .hyperframes/render-outputs.json. Anything still reading snapshots/ will find nothing. #5522

  • CLI: Save check, snapshot and render artifacts per revision (23d1fe5b4, #5522).
  • Studio: Record video state, edit targets and artifact cleanup in project history (893b4f675, #5524).
  • CLI: Guard history turns with --exclusive, --who and --if-open (7c73b3cae, #5518).

Catalog

  • Inspector: Publish @hyperframes/inspector to npm (f31b3c982, #5530).

Released on 2026-10-12.

Video frame injection now releases replaced image resources, keeping render memory from growing with every frame. Composition-wide audio effects and scene export fixes also ship in this release.

Features

  • Apply one audio effects chain across the whole composition, after clip and group effects. Set data-fx-chain on the top-level root. #5420

  • Exported video and audio now respect split scenes' in-points and inline scenes' start times, matching their placement in preview. #5454
  • A scene previewed or rendered alone uses its own master audio chain. #5474
  • Pitch-shifted exports keep the end of the clip and its effect tail. Bitcrush preview no longer starts with a silent hold after seeking. #5478
  • Studio history diagnostics include the server status and reason when an edit cannot be recorded as an undo step. #5489

Performance

  • Replaced video frames no longer accumulate cached image resources during capture. Engine-owned capture pages also retain less response data for DevTools inspection. #5494
  • Large audio effects mixes render in windows instead of loading the full mix into the browser. Parameter automation above 2 GiB remains unsupported. #5474

Catalog

  • The product-promo example no longer fails lint on conflicting CSS and GSAP transforms, allowing its browser audits to run. #5481

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.146

Released on 2026-10-11.

A split sub-composition now plays from its in-point in preview and on the timeline. FFmpeg installed while a preview runs is found without a restart, and exports no longer fail on a clip past the composition's end.

Features

  • Core: Truepeak, a lookahead true-peak limiter FX (3746703ea77, #5419).

Fixes

  • CLI: The browser download unpacks on machines without an unzip command (9e9b613ccf8, #5433).
  • CLI: Check warns when a video's browser-playable copy cannot be made (bf7f6deae93, #5441).
  • CLI: History reads answer while another app has the project open (489036c8439, #5445).
  • Core: A split sub-composition plays its videos from its in-point in preview and timeline (480807ec4be, #5413).
  • Parsers: Find ffmpeg installed after a long-running preview started (64c47cf3d1b, #5439).
  • Core: A runtime failure just before start-up is named too (721ebeafaa3, #5444).
  • Core: Slow clips stay on the playhead at reduced preview speeds (7d958fea0ba, #5440).
  • Producer: Exports no longer fail on a video clip outside the composition's length (81f60dbc985, #5431).
  • Parsers: Find FFmpeg and FFprobe installed by the project's npm installer packages (748cda90697, #5434).
  • Core: A runtime that fails to start names its real error instead of a half-built page (3aba29ce056, #5406).
  • CLI: Preview --background reports a preview that cannot start instead of waiting it out (6c96ea53443, #5437).
  • Lint: A double-quoted media src with an apostrophe is read whole, not reported missing (a9823f719df, #5411).
  • Studio: Studio's own text reads without em or en dashes (9825614d91d, #5414).
  • Engine: Copy border-width/style/color onto the replacement video frame (e23b3a3e31d, #3993).
  • CLI: Timeline split keeps a sub-composition's place in both halves (165be851328, #5410).

Performance

  • Packages: Ship npm packages without source maps and guard their size in CI (bb9e507e840, #5403).
  • Engine: Re-renders reuse the extracted frames of remote videos (b6467d91315, #5408).

Catalog

  • Catalog: Publish generated catalog (faa4913c9ef, #4340).
  • Ci: Let the catalog republish remove its stale simulated-cursor page and superseded fonts (f2b81b24151, #5432).
